role: Tests for CloudKitSessionFreshness last-writer-wins: decide() on whole-second modifiedAt stamps, record stamping, overwrite() of server records (yield, restore-over-tombstone, restore marker, stale-field clearing), replacing() on pull (local-only HealthKit fields and sleep window kept), uploadable payload stripping of HealthKit readings, refusal to build records for HealthKit-sourced sessions, and modifiedAt Codable round-trip.
types: CloudKitSessionFreshnessTests: class — XCTestCase for cross-device session freshness
toplevel: Stored properties earlier/later are fixed fixture dates.
